Profile Glycol salicylate is a salicylic acid derivative used similarly to methyl salicylate (p.85) in topical rubefacient preparations in usual concentrations of 5 to 15% for the relief of muscular and rheumatic pain. Dipropylene glycol salicylate has been used in similar preparations.
